description: Synthetic multi-video corpus for deterministic video-first routing evaluation.

label_provenance.notes: Gold videos, chunks, and distractors were authored before router integration and are never derived from router rankings.

videos.title: Fermentation Basics: Salt, Time, and Temperature
videos.transcript_excerpt: A two percent salt brine suppresses unwanted microbes while vegetables ferment. Cooler temperatures slow fermentation and produce a steadier flavor.

chunks.text: For most vegetable ferments, start with a two percent salt brine measured against the combined water and vegetable weight.
Keep the jar cool and out of direct sunlight; lower temperatures slow the process and help flavor develop evenly.

videos.title: Knife Skills for Faster Weeknight Cooking
videos.transcript_excerpt: Use a stable cutting board, curl fingertips into a claw grip, and guide the blade with the knuckles.

chunks.text: Place a damp towel under the cutting board so it cannot slide while you work.
Curl your fingertips into a claw and let your knuckles guide the side of the knife.

videos.title: Fermentation in the Garden? Understanding Compost
videos.transcript_excerpt: Healthy compost is primarily aerobic decomposition. Turn a wet pile to restore oxygen and reduce sour anaerobic odors.

chunks.text: A working compost pile depends on aerobic decomposers, enough moisture, and pore space for oxygen.
If the pile smells sour and feels waterlogged, turn it and mix in dry browns to restore airflow.

videos.title: Vector Search Explained
videos.transcript_excerpt: Dense embeddings retrieve semantic neighbors while BM25 rewards lexical overlap. Hybrid search can fuse both rankings.

chunks.text: Cosine similarity compares the direction of embedding vectors, capturing semantic relationships beyond exact words.
BM25 remains strong for names and exact terms, so hybrid retrieval can fuse lexical and dense rankings.

videos.title: Office Hours 42
videos.transcript_excerpt: For a large video library, retrieve relevant videos with multiple profile vectors first, then search transcript chunks only inside the selected videos.

chunks.text: At library scale, route the question to a small set of candidate videos before running detailed chunk retrieval.
Represent each video with identity, overview, and section vectors so a weak title does not hide a relevant transcript.

videos.title: RAG at Scale: Sharding the Document Store
videos.transcript_excerpt: This infrastructure session covers tenant-aware database sharding, replication, and queue backpressure rather than semantic video selection.

chunks.text: Tenant-aware shards keep document-store indexes bounded and simplify operational isolation.
Replication lag and queue backpressure are the dominant concerns during shard rebalancing.

videos.title: Why the Mercator Projection Distorts Area
videos.transcript_excerpt: Mercator preserves local angles for navigation but increasingly stretches area toward the poles.

chunks.text: The Mercator projection preserves angles, which made compass bearings easier to plot for navigation.
Its scale grows toward the poles, so high-latitude land masses appear much larger than their true area.

videos.title: Reading an Azimuthal Map
videos.transcript_excerpt: Azimuthal projections show true directions from a chosen center point but distort other properties away from that center.

chunks.text: An azimuthal projection preserves directions from its selected center.
Distance, shape, or area distortion grows as locations move away from that center.

videos.title: Deep Ocean Circulation
videos.transcript_excerpt: Cold, salty water becomes dense and sinks, helping drive thermohaline circulation through the deep ocean.

chunks.text: Cooling and sea-ice formation can make seawater colder, saltier, and dense enough to sink.
Those density differences help power slow thermohaline circulation across ocean basins.

videos.title: Solar Power on a Flexible Grid
videos.transcript_excerpt: Solar output follows daylight and clouds. Storage, demand response, and geographic diversity help balance its variability.

chunks.text: Solar generation is predictable at the day scale but varies with cloud cover and falls to zero at night.
Batteries, flexible demand, and wider transmission footprints help the grid absorb solar variability.

videos.title: Wind Forecasting for Grid Operators
videos.transcript_excerpt: Wind ramps can occur at any hour. Forecast ensembles and geographically dispersed turbines reduce balancing surprises.

chunks.text: Unlike the solar day-night cycle, wind ramps can arrive at any hour and require short-term forecasting.
Ensemble forecasts and geographic diversity reduce aggregate wind forecast error.
